description: This file defines the SelectedGroupField entity class, which appears to be part of an Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) setup using Doctrine annotations. The class models a many-to-one relationship linking selected group fields, summary display fields, and reports within the core plugin of the OrangeHRM system, facilitating database persistence of these combinations.

classes.name: SelectedGroupField
classes.description: An ORM entity class representing a linkage between a GroupField, a SummaryDisplayField, and a Report, uniquely identified by a composite key of these three fields.
